_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ia sibawa Pemain {player_id} ri olahraga LinesOfAction.
Ragammu na ' {side} ', ragam lawanmu na ' {other} '.
Format pergerakan: `[b1b3]` (dari-koordinat ka-koordinat).  Pergerakan sing sah meluncur horizontal, vertikal, atau diagonal ri bilangan petak sing sama ri jumlah ragam (warna riwang) ri garis iko. Ia bisa melompati ragammu dewe, tapi ndewene melompati ragam lawanmu; mendarat ri lawanmu menangkap iko.  Menang ri waktu ragammu salawas 8-tetangga terhubung.

invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Iyyaro kedoe parellui riolo iyyarega diagonal.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Harusu'i ripalecce jarakna pada sibawa bagiang iyya massisompung.
invalid_move.destination_own: Destinasi iya rionroie pole seddi tau.
